Set 05 of 07

Étoile

Liquid chrome, set crystal

kr 520

Made to order in Copenhagen · VAT included · delivery & returns

Made to order, about two weeks

Finish
Mirror chrome
Shape
Almond · Medium
Wear
2–3 weeks

Chrome is a powder, not a polish. It is burnished into a cured base with a silicone tip until the surface stops being a coating and starts being a mirror, and any dust under it shows for ever.

The crystals are set one at a time into gel and cured in place rather than glued on afterwards. Glued stones are the ones that leave. These sit slightly below the top coat, which is why the set still feels smooth.

  • Ten hand-finished nails, plus two spares
  • Twelve sizes in the box — no fitting needed
  • Glue, adhesive tabs, a mini file and a cuticle stick
  • Reusable: soaked off gently, a set goes back on four or five times
